annotations.title: Assemble Playground clips into one film

description: Stitch 2–12 finished video nodes, in the given order, into one film. Creates an "Assemble film" (video-stitch) node wired from the clips and queues the existing FFmpeg film worker, which normalizes the clips, concatenates them and attaches the MP4 to that node. Clips must be generated video nodes in this project's storage sharing one 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 aspect ratio. Free: no credits are spent. Returns immediately; poll playground_run_delivery with the returned runId (every ≥30 s) until verified, or read the stitch node's generated URL with playground_node_get.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

videoNodeIds.description: Source video node IDs in the order they should appear in the assembled video.
